title: Exploratory CUDA training from scratch on matched IBM-OM crossbars
hypothesis: Starting from the same AIHWKit-default random logical weights and the same programmed, subsequently faulted IBM-OM slow-array state, ten supervised MNIST epochs will reveal whether hybrid pulse-Adam or Tiki-Taka can learn the task directly in the crossbar. Fixed epoch-10 apparent-state accuracy and teacher-to-student KL are co-primary descriptive outcomes; persistent-state metrics are diagnostics.
motivation: The preceding recovery study began from a pretrained teacher deployment and was too slow to complete all endpoints. This one-endpoint exploratory control removes teacher initialization and all off-chip adaptation while retaining the same OM source/fast-device models, assignment seeds, published 13.48% corruption transition, native sampled bounds, direct q coordinate, data order, and ten-epoch budget. The frozen teacher is loaded only to compute agreement and KL, never to initialize or update the student.

arms.description: Hybrid pulse-Adam from matched random P&V initialization, using ground-truth cross-entropy and digital Adam moments.
Tiki-Taka v1 from the same slow-array state, with an independent OM fast array carrying the published corruption model.

completion_criteria: Both declared configs complete exactly once through the native ebl runner on CUDA and pass artifact verification.

Both arms use seed 42 and byte-identical AIHWKit-AnalogLinear-default Kaiming-uniform logical weights, direct q with no mapping or [0,2] clipping, native sampled bounds, slow assignment 87004, endpoint 89402, and the same post-P&V published-companion defect overlay.

The random initializer reproduces torch.nn.Linear.reset_parameters: Kaiming uniform with a=sqrt(5) in [out,in] layout followed by transpose to the comparator's [in,out] layout. The teacher checkpoint is evaluation-only.
Each arm consumes ten ordered epochs of 55,000 ground-truth-labelled examples: 3,438 minibatches per epoch, 34,380 optimizer steps, and no checkpoint selection.

The slow-array published fault source enables corrupt_devices_prob=0.1348 and corrupt_devices_range=0.01 after matched healthy P&V. Tiki-Taka's independent fast OM array uses the same published corruption model and is commissioned toward literal q=0 without a fault mask.

Headline metrics are apparent-state accuracy and teacher-to-crossbar KL on the same first 1,000 official MNIST test examples at fixed epoch 10. Teacher agreement and hidden persistent-state accuracy/KL are reported separately.
This remains a one-assignment, one-programming-stream exploratory fitted-preset result; it is not promoted to paper evidence, an array-level uncertainty estimate, or a fabricated-device claim.
analysis_plan: Verify source logical-weight hashes, source population fingerprint, healthy P0 state hashes, published fault mask, and faulted pretraining state hashes match exactly across the two arms.
Report epoch-by-epoch apparent accuracy, teacher agreement, teacher KL, cross-entropy, and the corresponding persistent diagnostics for each optimizer.

Compare fixed epoch-10 apparent accuracy and KL without selecting an earlier epoch. Label Adam hybrid because its moment state is digital; Tiki-Taka has no digital weight shadow or Adam moments and uses an additional physical fast array.
If either method is promising, expand that exact frozen recipe to the remaining three endpoint streams in a new study rather than treating this one stream as a population conclusion.
